issues.claim: retainedsearch.ajuliaexecutivesearch.com: "No business content visible; not signed in and no credentials entered."
issues.problem: Contradicted. The page shows the Ajulia Executive Search logo with the tagline "Bridging the gap between possibility and reality" above the Email Address / Password / LOGIN fields - the auditor's own screenshot_retainedsearch_login_1440.png shows it, and my live view at 1280 px shows it too. It is a branded sign-in screen, not an unbranded one. Nothing else in the sentence is wrong (Email Address, Password, LOGIN, Forgotten your password?, English US all confirmed).
issues.fix: Reword to something like "Ajulia-branded sign-in screen (logo and tagline only, no services or contact details): Email Address, Password, LOGIN, Forgotten your password?, English US. Not signed in; no credentials entered."

issues.claim: likely_cause: "Apex and www resolve to Cloudflare addresses (172.64.80.1 for the apex, 172.67.213.38 / 104.21.45.105 for www)"
issues.problem: Not reproducible. dns.google today returns 172.67.213.38 and 104.21.45.105 for BOTH the apex and www; 172.64.80.1 does not appear for the apex. The value is not in audit_md or founder_md, but as written it is a specific, checkable number that no longer holds (resolver/anycast variation or a later DNS change - either way it cannot be stated as fact).
issues.fix: Drop the specific apex address or write: "apex and www both answer with Cloudflare addresses (today 172.67.213.38 / 104.21.45.105), while jobs answers 69.167.165.235" - which still supports the point that the names are decided in Cloudflare's configuration.

issues.claim: retainedsearch: "Loads a JavaScript-driven sign-in screen (browser title 'Loading')"
issues.problem: The browser title today reads "Login", not "Loading" (the title changes as the app boots). As recorded it is a moment-in-time artefact presented as a property of the page.
issues.fix: Remove the title from the description, or note it as "title read 'Loading' while the page initialised, then 'Login'".

issues.problem: The body is 302 words by a straight whitespace count (markdown markers excluded), i.e. marginally over the 300-word limit.
issues.fix: Trim about five words - e.g. shorten "The website link on the Google listing, ajuliaexecutivesearch.com, redirects to" and the closing 'Prepared from publicly available information' line.

issues.claim: audit_md never mentions the NJDOL stop-work order while the record says status "operating" and severity_reason says "the business is not represented online today"
issues.problem: Not false, and not hidden - the order, its date and the unconfirmed entity link are set out in caveats, fix_steps and the founder_md source list. But the owner-facing page reads as if the firm is simply trading with a broken website. If the April 2025 order is still in force (the NJDOL release says it stays until the liability is paid in full, and no later notice was found), that is the most important fact about this business today.
issues.fix: Optional but recommended: one neutral line in audit_md or a flag to the founder that the stop-work order should be checked before any contact, e.g. "We also saw a state labour notice from May 2025 about an affiliated payroll entity; we have not verified its current status." Keep the existing 'not confirmed' labelling.
